en: Colorized historic postcard showing a tall rectangular stone clock tower with multiple stories and arched windows. A clock face is visible near the top and several flags fly from the roof. At the base of the tower, a crowd of people is gathered. The sky is tinted pink and blue. Multilingual captions (French, Ottoman Turkish, and German) are printed at the top, and a small logo or URL appears near the bottom.
